apache/shenyu.about: Java-native API gateway for service proxy, protocol conversion and API governance.
apache/shenyu.did: Gateway hardening across `sync`, `divide` and the connection plugins: trusted WebSocket cluster masters are validated before their credentials are used, `divide` gained sticky-session affinity plus draining and readiness admission, and Dubbo, MQTT and gRPC lifecycles were tightened. The rest is failure-path correctness — heartbeats, identity resolution, header ownership per invocation.

agentic-ai-java/argi.about: Agent Runtime and Graph Intelligence: a Java agent framework built on Spring AI, with a graph runtime, multi-agent workflows and visual administration.
agentic-ai-java/argi.did: Agent-layer correctness in the standalone ReAct path: interceptor-set system messages now reach model requests, interceptor tool selection and dynamic registries are honoured, and cancellation actually stops work — late stream subscriptions are dropped and in-flight A2A calls abort their HTTP exchange. Earlier: typed tool-argument validation, a unified tool-failure contract and the AgentResult delivery contract.

agentscope-ai/agentscope.about: Build and run agents you can see, understand and trust - a Python framework for multi-agent applications.
agentscope-ai/agentscope.did: Model-layer parity in the Python framework: `thinking_enable` is now tri-state for DeepSeek and DashScope, so an unset value no longer force-sends `thinking.type=disabled`, and realtime TTS surfaces `streaming_call` failures after cold start instead of dropping the text delta. Next: structured-output fallback for Ollama.
